extra.reason: All acceptance criteria met: loopback-only secure defaults, 4-component health separation, log redaction, 80 deterministic tests (all passing), public/operator/contributor docs complete.

Workspace discovery: injectable WorkspaceService, fixture implementation, /api/channels, /api/channels/:c/series, /api/channels/:c/series/:s/episodes, /api/channels/:c/series/:s/episodes/:e endpoints with params validation and graceful 404s. 80 tests pass.
Workspace file watcher: recursive fs.watch with debounce, episode slug inference, EventBus integration for workspace-change events.
Editor read/write APIs: GET/PUT artifact files with atomic writes, revision detection (SHA-256 If-Match header), path traversal protection, revision history endpoint.
Review thread APIs: create threads, add messages, update message status, anchor-based threading, JSON file storage, EventBus integration.

Strict Pi RPC JSONL client: custom \n-only line parser (preserves U+2028/U+2029 in JSON strings), request ID correlation, timeout/error handling, stderr separation, connection lifecycle (connected/disconnected/reconnecting/shutdown), fire-and-forget notifications. 20 RPC unit tests + 100 total tests pass.

Pi process manager: one process per episode policy, session reuse on reconnect, idle eviction with configurable timeout, max concurrent process enforcement, event bus integration for state changes, graceful shutdown. 10 process-manager tests + 110 total tests pass.

GUI intent routing: 8 intent types (prompt, steer, follow-up, approve, rerun, edit, review, cancel) mapped to Pi RPC commands via /api/intent endpoint. Request/notification dispatch, error handling, event bus integration. 10 intent tests.
Pi UI bridge: ExtensionBridge for browser-Pi request/response, UiRequest/UiResponse with timeout, SSE event publishing, /api/ui/respond and /api/ui/pending endpoints. 5 bridge tests. 125 total tests.
